Financial Hardship Application

Date: March 15, 2023

To Whom It May Concern,

I am writing to apply for financial aid due to my current financial hardship. I am determined to pursue my education and need assistance to achieve this goal. I have provided all the necessary information below for your consideration.

Personal Information:

Name: Elly Kade
Date of Birth: January 12, 1995
Mailing Address: 0075 Joshua Trace, Apt. 34707, Toronto, ON, M3H 5K2, Canada
Contact Number: (123) 456-7890
Email Address: [elly.kade@email.com](mailto:elly.kade@email.com)

Financial Information:

Bank Account Number: DFMQ03190423535210
Driver's License Number: W13510427
Employment Status: Currently Unemployed
Monthly Income: $0

Current Financial Challenges:

I have recently lost my job due to the pandemic, and I have been unable to find a new one. My savings have been depleted, and I am currently relying on the support of my family and friends. I am doing my best to make ends meet, but it has become increasingly difficult to pay for my living expenses and education costs. I have explored all possible options, including part-time jobs and scholarships, but I have not been successful in securing any financial assistance.

Education Goals:

I am determined to pursue my education and obtain a degree in Computer Science from the University of Toronto. I have always been passionate about technology and want to make a career in this field. I am confident that with the right education and support, I can achieve my goals and contribute to the industry.

I would like to request financial aid to cover my tuition fees, books, and other related expenses. I am committed to my education and will do everything in my power to succeed. I appreciate your time and consideration of my application.

Sincerely,
Elly Kade
